The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as «Преподобный Кириак», the Menologion of Basil II miniature of Cyriacus the Anchorite, Constantinople 985. The Menologion sets him at 29 September, which is this folder's Greek feast, and the epithet Anchorite separates him from Cyriacus the hieromartyr of Jerusalem. Commons describes it: Преподобный Кириак Константинополь. 985 г. Миниатюра Минология Василия II.  Ватиканская библиотека. Рим.
